workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.description: Peer assessment in phases: learners hand in work and assess each other's with the teacher's form

workshop.title: Title

about.accumulative: Each criterion gets points; the grade is their weighted share of the most.
about.comments: Reviewers comment on each aspect, without points: every assessed work gets the highest grade, so the teacher usually sets the final one.
about.numerrors: Reviewers say whether each assertion holds; the weighted number of errors gives the grade, by the table or evenly.
about.rubric: Each criterion has levels with points; the grade is where the points chosen lie between the least and the most.

form.mappingHint: The grade (%) for a weighted number of errors; numbers not in the table share the grade evenly.
